newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH SHARES UP ON H1 RESULTS, MORE GAINS SEEN.
newsitem.headline: DANISH SHARES UP ON H1 RESULTS, MORE GAINS SEEN.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Wednesday, fuelled by encouraging first-half 1997 corporate results, with dealers seeing the positive trend persisting.
"The Novo and SAS results were better than expected and the 1996/97 B&O performance was good too, this should help the index up again tomorrow," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index gained 0.98 point to close at 185.53 in overall bourse turnover of 1.275 billion crowns. The KFX August future rose 0.60 point to 185.10 with 955 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Novo finished eight crowns higher at 712, SAS put on nine to end up at 114, while B&O fell five to close at 365.
Den Danske Bank completed the day an impressive 17 crowns up at 727, ahead of its 1997 interim result due next week.
